rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that is alive rather than dead.

example.english: He's still living, so don't worry.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 saang1 gaa3 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use 生計 as the all-purpose noun for a livelihood or means of financial support.

example.english: They make a living by running a business.
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 zou6 saang1 ji3 wai4 ci4 sang1 gai3

rows.note: Use 生命 for the state or fact of being alive, rather than for living people or a lifestyle.

example.english: Living is precious, so we should cherish every day.
example.traditional: 生命好寶貴，我哋要珍惜每一日。
example.jyutping: sang1 ming6 hou2 bou2 gwai3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zan1 sik1 mui5 jat1 jat6

rows.traditional: 仲有人 V 緊 嘅 N
rows.jyutping: zung6 jau5 jan4 V gan2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for something still actively used, especially a language that people still speak.

example.english: Hakka is a living language that people still speak, and it should not disappear.
example.traditional: 客家話係仲有人講緊嘅語言，唔應該消失。
example.jyutping: haak3 gaa1 waa2 hai6 zung6 jau5 jan4 gong2 gan2 ge3 jyu5 jin4 m4 jing1 goi1 siu1 sat1

rows.note: Use this written term when “living” means still existing or extant rather than actively used.

example.english: There are not many living copies of this old book, so the museum must preserve them carefully.
example.traditional: 呢部古籍嘅現存抄本唔多，博物館要小心保管。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gu2 zik6 ge3 jin6 cyun4 caau1 bun2 m4 do1 bok3 mat6 gun2 jiu3 siu2 sam1 bou2 gun2

rows.note: Use 活人 when referring to people who are alive, especially in contrast with the dead.

example.english: There are living people still at the scene, so call an ambulance!
example.traditional: 現場仲有活人，快啲叫救護車！
example.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 zung6 jau5 wut6 jan4 faai3 di1 giu3 gau3 wu6 ce1

rows.note: Use 生活方式 specifically for a person's style or pattern of life.

example.english: I want to change my way of living and stop staying up late all the time.
example.traditional: 我想轉吓生活方式，唔好成日捱夜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zyun2 haa5 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je6
